hero.headline: Beachside calm.
hero.lead: A fully renovated two-bedroom coastal apartment with beautiful interiors, generous outdoor living and an easy Bargara lifestyle just moments from the beach.

seo.title: Koola Palms Bargara | Apartment 101 Beach Accommodation
seo.description: Stay at Koola Palms Apartment 101 in Bargara: a fully renovated 2-bedroom ground-floor apartment near the beach, Mon Repos and the Southern Great Barrier Reef.
seo.socialDescription: A fully renovated two-bedroom coastal apartment in Bargara with designer interiors, private outdoor living and the beach close by.
